shared_elements: human figure in profile, striding, low relief
hand grasping a held object (staff / vessel)
rounded rosette-like motif (rosette band in A; ring/rosette object in B)
justification: Both show a striding human figure in strict profile carved in low relief, with a hand closed around a held object, careful rendering of patterned garment edges and stylised hair, and small rosette-like discs appear in each. But A is a horizontal frieze whose main subject is a two-humped camel led by an attendant beneath a band of rosettes, whereas B is a single monumental winged, bearded, human-headed figure filling the whole panel with no animal, no register band and no procession.
